context: Aoi welcomes Riku back and hears a surprise.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ただいま/驚く/引い/なろ/っぽい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ただいま!今日、すごいこと起きたよ。
lines.en: I'm back! Something amazing happened today.
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おかえり!何があったの、驚くこと?
lines.en: Welcome back! What happened, something surprising?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: くじ引いたら、一等が当たったんだ!
lines.en: I drew a lottery and won first prize!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えー、本当?すごく驚いた!
lines.style: amazed barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大人っぽい時計が、もらえたんだ。
lines.style: proud teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいなあ、急に大人になろうとしてる?
lines.en: Lucky, are you suddenly trying to be grown-up?
lines.style: teasing barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まだ子供っぽいけど、嬉しいよ!

lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: くじを引いて、運がいいねぇ!
